news.headline: Abivax Earnings Are Imminent; Most Accurate Analysts Revise Forecasts Ahead of Earnings Call
news.summary: Ahead of Abivax's H1 2026 results due after the close on Monday, Sept. 21, 2026, top analysts hold bullish price targets including Piper Sandler ($175), Jefferies ($158), Truist ($155) and Wedbush ($110); consensus expects a loss of $1.08 per share on revenue of $1.86 million.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Abivax Stock Coverage With Buy Rating
news.summary: Goldman Sachs started coverage of Abivax with a Buy rating and $155 price target, calling obefazimod a 'multiblockbuster' opportunity and modeling roughly €4 billion in peak ulcerative-colitis sales plus an additional €3.5 billion in Crohn's disease; shares rose about 3% to €104.2 on Euronext Paris on the news.

news.headline: The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?
news.summary: STAT examines why Abivax remains an independent, publicly traded company despite a red-hot biotech M&A market and obefazimod's blockbuster commercial potential in ulcerative colitis, noting its $920 million July 2026 capital raise reduced the company's urgency to sell.

news.headline: Abivax Short Interest Jumps 42.1% in August
news.summary: Short interest in Abivax ADRs rose 42.1% during August 2026 to about 1.62 million shares (from 1.14 million shares on August 15), equal to roughly 2.4% of the float and a short-interest ratio of about 1.1 days of average volume.

news.headline: Piper Sandler Raises Abivax Stock Price Target to $175 on UC Data
news.summary: Piper Sandler analyst Allison Bratzel raised her price target on Abivax to $175 from $165 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing increased revenue estimates for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis following the ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 readout and the company's recent equity financing.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 Financial Results & Investor Call
catalysts.detail: Abivax reports H1 2026 financial results after the U.S. market close on Monday, September 21, 2026, with an investor conference call to follow. Expect an updated cash position (was €491.6M as of March 31, 2026; runway guided into Q4 2029 after the $920M July ADS raise), reaffirmation of the late-Q4 2026 NDA filing timeline, and likely management commentary on continued takeover/M&A speculation.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA Submission for Obefazimod in Ulcerative Colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax has guided to submit its first New Drug Application to the FDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis in late Q4 2026, following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA on July 30, 2026 that aligned on submission content and strategy. This is the single largest near-term regulatory catalyst for the stock and a key de-risking event ahead of the option's March 2027 expiry.

catalysts.label: EMA MAA Submission for Obefazimod in UC
catalysts.detail: Abivax intends to submit a Marketing Authorization Application to the European Medicines Agency for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis in the second half of 2026, supported by the positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction and maintenance trial results reported in 2025-2026.

catalysts.label: UEG Week 2026 (Barcelona, Oct 17-20)
catalysts.detail: United European Gastroenterology (UEG) Week runs October 17-20, 2026 in Barcelona. Abivax has presented late-breaking obefazimod UC/IBD data at UEG in prior years (including October 2025 in Berlin); a similar 2026 presentation slot is expected given the company's conference history, but Abivax had not yet formally announced its 2026 UEG abstracts as of September 19, 2026.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's Disease Induction Data
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction data from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial evaluating obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease is expected around mid-2027, shortly after the March 2027 option expiry. Goldman Sachs models roughly €3.5 billion in peak Crohn's sales potential for obefazimod, making any interim trial update a watch item.

catalysts.label: Potential M&A / Takeover
catalysts.detail: Speculation about a large-pharma acquisition of Abivax (including a reported ~€15B Eli Lilly approach per La Lettre in January 2026) has persisted through 2026 without a confirmed deal. CEO Marc de Garidel has said the company is 'in no rush' and raised $920M in July 2026 to fund a potential solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer. A surprise bid before March 2027 would be a major catalyst for the call option.

pulse: ABVX trades around $106 (close of $105.99 on Sept 17, 2026, prior close $102.23), within a wide 52-week range of $69.81-$148.83, as investors await H1 2026 results due after the close on Monday, September 21, 2026 and the pivotal late-Q4 2026 FDA NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis. Sentiment has turned more constructive recently — Goldman Sachs initiated coverage at Buy with a $155 target on September 10 (~€4B peak UC sales, ~€3.5B peak Crohn's sales) — but the stock stays volatile on recurring, unconfirmed takeover speculation that STAT News noted on September 3 has still not produced a deal. With cash runway extended into Q4 2029 after the $920M July capital raise, the near-term narrative has shifted from an imminent buyout toward NDA execution and Abivax's stated plan to prepare a standalone U.S. commercial launch.
